title: tunnelmind:crew_ops:v1 — AIT constraints
description: Validates the `constraints` object of an ATAP v0.1 AIT declared under the tunnelmind:crew_ops:v1 profile. The canonical-byte serialization of `constraints` MUST NOT exceed 4096 bytes (ATAP v0.1 §6.2).

allowed_agents.description: Agents the rails may decide for. Capped at 50 ids of at most 64 characters to respect the 4 KB constraints ceiling.

max_class.description: Highest autonomy class any agent may be granted. Class 4 is never grantable.

agent.description: A crew agent id (crew-<name>) or an agent role. No `@`, spaces or capitals, so it cannot carry a person's name or email.
